items.text: Final report: Kansas City ruled out WR Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee), RT Jaylon Moore (concussion) and RB Brashard Smith; LT Josh Simmons went to IR. CB L'Jarius Sneed (knee) and LB Cooper McDonald are questionable; Patrick Mahomes has no designation.

Final report: Seattle ruled out RB Zach Charbonnet (knee) and LBs Chazz Surratt and Drake Thomas; DeMarcus Lawrence, Uchenna Nwosu, Connor O'Toole and S Nick Emmanwori are questionable. Sam Darnold starts; Drew Lock (elbow) is questionable.

adjust.reason: Kansas City is without both starting tackles (Simmons on IR, Moore out) and WR Rashee Rice, which outweighs Seattle's two linebackers and backup running back. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
